entries.28dcb1b8efe4cb83: 'i-Filter' is filtering software targeted at homes, libraries, internet cafés and similar venues, and it controls access to harmful sites from smartphones, tablets and PCs.
entries.29e1b43d423de5a4: 'm-FILTER' consists of email filtering, email archiving and anti-spam functions, and is used for targeted email attack countermeasures, prevention of misdirected emails, spam email countermeasures and similar purposes. It determines the safety of senders using a whitelist-based database that stores safe senders.
entries.2bd199493095427c: 'a-FILTER' is an integrated authentication platform providing single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, ID synchronization, log management and similar functions. 'Z-FILTER' is a network security solution that provides ID authentication, device control, communication control and visibility of cloud service use, among other functions, on a single management screen; official sales began in November 2025.
entries.86494a2d949ea713: A domestic security software maker that plans, develops and sells Web and email security software, listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.d251b1ab0957ffd3: 'FinalCode' is a passwordless encryption service that can track and remotely control electronic files, enabling designation of viewers, changes to permissions and remote file deletion. 'f-FILTER' is a data protection and file transfer solution for securely transmitting important information.
